meshy_wall._scope: F38 P2-094, presentation only: Meshy homestead wall (assets/props/meshy-1020/homestead_wall_segment, provenance there) fitted to the kit wall bounds. Every hero mesh is presentation_only, so the BuildPiece collider, grid, cost and save are unchanged.
meshy_wall._why_tint: F38 P2-094 r1 judges (5.60): the infill read blown-out near-white; a warm multiply brings it to the village plaster value.
meshy_wall._why_backing: F38 P2-094 r2 judges (6.15): one brace bay showed sky, and the infill read flat; an inset warm kit-plaster backing closes it and adds texture.
meshy_wall._why_r4: F38 P2-094 r3 judges (6.40): timber new-orange, plaster flat-bright, no top cap; darker weathered multiply and an oak coping cap.
meshy_wall._why_enabled: F38 P2-094 code-blind item pass, 21 Oct 2026 (CPU-provisional): before 3.5 -> after 6.73 (judges 6.9/6.9/6.4, r4), defect FIXED by all three; smoke_free_build PASS with it ON; ralph/reports/LOOK/close-1020/F38-items-r1.md.

r5._scope: F38 P2-094 r5 candidate (OFF until judged): GPU yardstick asks (5.96 mapped) - the infill was the brightest surface in frame, no grounding, a lone segment read as an outhouse door, thin cap.

r6._scope: F38 P2-094 r6 candidate (OFF until judged): a Meshy remake (assets/props/meshy-1022/homestead_wall_segment_v2, coordinator-generated for the lane's MESHY request, provenance there): ochre wattle-and-daub infill, two braces, real beam depth, a cap with a drip edge and a fieldstone plinth. r5 judges (6.18): flat pale infill, card-thin panel. Fitted to the kit wall bounds like the r4 model; its own textures, so no tint, backing, cap or posts.
r6._why_r6b: r6 first render (unjudged): the lit ochre infill washed out paler than r5; a warm darkening multiply and r5 dark oak end posts.

r7._scope: F38 P2-094 r7 (ON, CPU-provisional; see _why_on): r5 with a much darker infill. Run-fixture judges (r5 6.29) still read the infill as near-white and blown out under noon sun.
r7._why_on: P2-094 r7 ON as a CPU-provisional improvement, not a closure: mapped 6.50 vs shipping 6.05 on the snapped-run fixture (three code-blind judges, Low/Compatibility llvmpipe, ralph/reports/LOOK/close-1022/P2-094.md). Parked by the gain rule; a GPU pass decides.

r8._scope: World dressing r8 candidate (OFF until GPU judged; tb/world-dressing). GPU 6.65 (31 Oct): 'a clean flat freestanding slab with no weathering, ground contact or footing'. Layers on r7: a half-sunk fieldstone plinth course on both faces from the installed nature rocks, a damp mud-splash grime band fading up the lower 0.7 m, and installed grass tufts against the base. Presentation only; collider, grid, cost and save unchanged.
